proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Around $10 free credits on registration (no card required initially). Low-cost pricing ($0.003/image for FLUX-schnell).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides lightning-fast inference for FLUX-schnell, FLUX-dev, and highly optimized SDXL models with clean, easy-to-use SDKs and HTTP APIs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: GitHub Actions image generation step in 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_kdp_cover' pipelines as a direct replacement/fallback for Pollinations.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Credits expire eventually; requires monitoring usage to stay within free credits or transition to extremely low-cost PAYG.

proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts any URL (including search results and product pages) into clean, LLM-friendly markdown, bypassing basic anti-scraping walls.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Used in 'agent_trendhunter' and 'agent_opportunity_hunter' to extract trending topics directly from Etsy search result URLs or web articles.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Heavy anti-bot sites like Amazon or Cloudflare-protected domains may still occasionally block requests.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 150 daily tokens (generates approximately 15-30 high-quality images daily for free).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Offers specialized models tuned for game assets, isometric items, and highly stylized illustration styles far superior to raw SDXL/Flux.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrated into 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' and 'produce_coloring_book' to generate high-value vectorizable templates.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Free tier API access requires registering on their developer portal and has lower concurrency limits.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 200 credits per month free (enough for ~20 text-to-3D or image-to-3D generations).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Generates high-quality textured 3D meshes (.obj / .gltf) directly from text prompts or 2D image inputs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: In 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack' or a new 3D model delivery pipeline, uploading the outputs directly to Cults3D or Thangs.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Generated meshes might require manual decimation or cleanup for production-ready game development.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to upload, list, and monetize 3D files with direct designer program integration.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: A massive, fast-growing 3D model search engine and marketplace that actively indexes and drives organic traffic to creators' models.
proposals.would_integrate_where: An automated distribution pipeline alongside Cults3D to upload STL files produced by 'produce_stl_parametric'.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires STL files to be genuinely printable or functional to gain traction and positive reviews.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Unlimited access to a rotating selection of free models (e.g., Llama 3.1 8B, Gemma 2 9B) with no credit card required.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Acts as a unified interface for dozens of LLM providers, making it incredibly easy to swap models if one provider goes down.
proposals.would_integrate_where: The base LLM call layer in 'agent_orchestrator' as a redundant fallback for Gemini text generation.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Free models can experience high latency or temporary rate-limiting during peak global usage times.
